title: llms.txt: self-contained index with auth, base URLs and every endpoint per collection
description:
## Why
/llms.txt only lists one link per collection, so an LLM reading it learns nothing about Shiprocket endpoints, auth or base URLs without fetching the ~1MB full rendering.

## Scope
backend/internal/export/markdown/index.go (new), markdown.go (drop old Index), httpapi/docs.go, tests. ~250 lines.

## Validation
go test ./... green; /llms.txt shows per-collection Base URL, Authentication, intro paragraph, and every endpoint grouped by tag with link to /docs/<slug>/<opId>.md

title: M6: Try-it proxy for Scalar (guarded upstream forwarder)
description:
## Why
Scalar's Test Request button calls target APIs from the browser; most APIs block cross-origin calls, so the portal needs a server-side forwarder implementing Scalar's proxy contract (?scalar_url=).

## Scope
backend/internal/proxy (handler, header filtering, size/time limits, host allowlist, netguard), httpapi wiring + 60/min/IP limit, frontend proxyUrl config, README. ~8 files, ~450 lines incl. tests.

## Validation
httptest: forwards method/headers/body and returns upstream status; strips Cookie/hop-by-hop; private target 403; host outside allowlist 403; oversize upstream truncated with X-Proxy-Truncated; 61st request 429; OPTIONS preflight 204.
close_reason: Proxy implemented with netguard, allowlist, header filtering, size/time limits, 60/min/IP; unit + router tests green; live relay verified.

title: M4: admin auth + import API for apidocs portal
description:
## Why
Milestone M4 of the approved plan: writes to the docs catalog must be gated behind a single admin login, and admins need an API/UI to import OpenAPI or Postman files and docs URLs.

## Scope
backend/internal/auth (bcrypt + HS256 JWT, gin middleware), backend/internal/httpapi (login w/ rate limit, admin create/reimport/delete), backend/internal/importsvc, backend/internal/netguard (SSRF guard), backend/internal/importer/source (guarded client), cmd wiring. ~19 files, ~750 lines incl. tests.

## Validation
httptest: 401 without/with bad token, 201 valid upload, 409 duplicate slug, 404 unknown slug on PUT/DELETE, 400 invalid spec, 413 oversize, 429 on 6th login, private URL blocked. Full suite with -race green.
close_reason: Implemented and verified locally: auth service, admin API, SSRF guard, admin UI; backend -race suite and 13 frontend tests green; live curl checks passed. Not yet committed (no remote).
